items.item_text: A valid driver’s license or equivalent alternate form of transportation to off-site meetings and events is required. A license or license eligibility as a psychologist in California is required.
A minimum of two or more years of clinical experience in the autism field.

Provide clinical care for neurodiverse individuals and their families including developmental and psychological assessments; social skills groups and related curricula development; and individual, group, and family therapy, including consultation and parent coaching.
Generate timely and appropriate clinical billing and documentation.
If relevant, attend weekly individual supervision with the Director.
Attend clinic meetings with the Director, staff, and students.
Assist in supervising graduate and undergraduate students.
Provide administrative and operational support including communication with prospective clients, appointment scheduling, clinical billing, and management of the clinic waitlist.
Facilitate relationships with community providers and community referral network.
A Ph.D. in Clinical Psychology or a closely related field, with clinical training in assessment and intervention for autism and related neurodevelopmental disorders, is required.
Demonstrate an understanding of, and appropriate adherence to, clinical ethics and codes of conduct.
Ability to attend to detail, multi-task, and use effective time management, planning, and organizational skills to perform responsibilities accurately and to meet expected deadlines.

Ability to cultivate an inclusive environment including a commitment to mentoring students and supporting clients representing a broad range of socioeconomic backgrounds, political opinions, genders, races, ethnicities, nationalities, sexual orientations, religions, and developmental and behavioral functioning.
Ability to follow instructions and to delegate appropriate tasks effectively.
Ability to work efficiently, cooperatively, and collaboratively with others.
Ability to receive and respond appropriately to constructive criticism.
Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing.
Knowledge of various computer systems such as Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

pay.source_text: The anticipated pay range is $35.00 - $40.00 per hour. Pay rate will be commensurate with experience and licensure status.
